# Launchpad
> Launchpad is Canonical’s collaboration platform for open source projects, providing code hosting, package building, bug tracking, translations, and project publishing.

Launchpad supports software development workflows around Ubuntu and other open source projects, including source package recipes, PPAs, code branches, bug reports, blueprints, translations, and project teams.

## Core Platform
- [Launchpad Home](https://launchpad.net/): Main entry point for projects, teams, packages, and development services.
- [Projects](https://launchpad.net/projects): Browse software projects hosted and tracked on Launchpad.
- [Distributions](https://launchpad.net/distros): Explore Linux distributions and distribution packages managed through Launchpad.
- [Teams](https://launchpad.net/people): Find users and teams participating in Launchpad projects.
- [Answers](https://answers.launchpad.net/): Community question-and-answer support for Launchpad-hosted projects.
- [Code](https://code.launchpad.net/): Access code branches, repositories, and merge proposal workflows.
- [Translations](https://translations.launchpad.net/): Manage and contribute localization for projects and distributions.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/): Official Launchpad documentation and user guidance.
- [Getting started](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/get-started/): Introductory guide to Launchpad concepts and first steps.
- [Projects](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/explanation/projects/): Overview of how projects are organized and managed in Launchpad.
- [Teams](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/explanation/teams/): Explanation of Launchpad teams, membership, and permissions.
- [Bugs](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/explanation/bugs/): Guide to bug tracking concepts and workflows in Launchpad.
- [Translations](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/explanation/translations/): Explanation of translation features and localization workflows.
- [PPAs](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/explanation/ppas/): Overview of personal package archives and package publishing.

## How-to Guides
- [Create a project](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/how-to/projects/create-a-project/): Steps for registering and configuring a new Launchpad project.
- [Create a team](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/how-to/teams/create-a-team/): Instructions for creating and administering a Launchpad team.
- [Report a bug](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/how-to/bugs/report-a-bug/): How to file useful bug reports against projects or packages.
- [Create a PPA](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/how-to/ppas/create-a-ppa/): Set up a personal package archive for building and publishing packages.
- [Upload packages to a PPA](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/how-to/ppas/upload-packages/): Publish source packages to a PPA for automated builds.
- [Request a translation import](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/how-to/translations/request-an-import/): Import translation templates and files into Launchpad.
- [Propose a merge](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/how-to/code/propose-a-merge/): Submit code changes for review using merge proposals.

## API and Integration
- [Web service API](https://launchpad.net/+apidoc): Reference entry point for the Launchpad web service API.
- [API devel docs](https://api.launchpad.net/devel.html): Developer-facing overview of Launchpad API resources and usage.
- [launchpadlib](https://launchpadlib.readthedocs.io/): Python client library documentation for the Launchpad API.
- [Launchpad API WADL](https://api.launchpad.net/devel/): Machine-readable API service root for Launchpad devel endpoints.
- [Code import service](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/explanation/code/imports/): Documentation for importing code from external repositories.
- [Recipes](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/explanation/packaging/recipes/): Explanation of source package recipes for automated builds.

## Packaging and Builds
- [Personal Package Archives](https://launchpad.net/ubuntu/+ppas): Entry point for Ubuntu PPAs hosted on Launchpad.
- [Build recipes](https://launchpad.net/+builds): View package and recipe build activity across Launchpad.
- [Soyuz](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/explanation/packaging/): Packaging and archive management concepts in Launchpad.
- [Source package recipes](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/explanation/packaging/recipes/): Define packages built from branches and packaging instructions.
- [Build farm](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/explanation/packaging/build-farm/): Overview of Launchpad’s package build infrastructure.
- [Publishing packages](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/how-to/ppas/upload-packages/): Workflow for uploading and publishing packages through PPAs.

## Collaboration Features
- [Bug tracker](https://bugs.launchpad.net/): Search and browse bug reports across Launchpad projects and packages.
- [Blueprints](https://blueprints.launchpad.net/): Track specifications and planning items for project development.
- [Merge proposals](https://code.launchpad.net/+merge-proposals): Review and discuss proposed code changes.
- [Answers tracker](https://answers.launchpad.net/): Ask and answer support questions for hosted projects.
- [Mailing lists](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/explanation/teams/mailing-lists/): Team mailing list support and communication features.
- [Translations overview](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/explanation/translations/): Collaborative translation workflow for software projects.

## Ubuntu and Distribution Workflows
- [Ubuntu packages](https://launchpad.net/ubuntu): Ubuntu distribution overview and package tracking on Launchpad.
- [Ubuntu source packages](https://launchpad.net/ubuntu/+packages): Browse source and binary packages in Ubuntu.
- [Series and releases](https://launchpad.net/ubuntu/+series): Ubuntu release series tracked in Launchpad.
- [Package bugs](https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu): Bug reports filed against Ubuntu packages and components.
- [Package translations](https://translations.launchpad.net/ubuntu): Ubuntu translation work managed through Launchpad.
- [Distribution documentation](https://documentation.ubuntu.com/launchpad/en/latest/user/explanation/distributions/): Concepts for distributions, series, and package management.

## Community and Support
- [Help wiki](https://help.launchpad.net/): Legacy Launchpad help resources and community documentation.
- [Support questions](https://answers.launchpad.net/launchpad): Ask questions specifically about using Launchpad itself.
- [Launchpad project](https://launchpad.net/launchpad): The Launchpad project page with bugs, code, and releases.
- [Launchpad bugs](https://bugs.launchpad.net/launchpad): Report and track issues affecting the Launchpad platform.
- [Launchpad blog](https://blog.launchpad.net/): News, updates, and announcements from the Launchpad team.
- [Status and announcements](https://blog.launchpad.net/category/announcement): Official announcements about Launchpad changes and operations.
